people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.
translations.bsb: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
translations.kjv: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
